claims.synthetic_user_and_observed_assistant_te: Exact UTF-8 text including original whitespace; original per-text hashes are independently checked
claims.semantic_helper_values: Exact JSON values, deduplicated by canonical SHA256 references; no execution-path or identity fields exported
claims.original_provenance_verification: Hashes bind to the retained private originals; the public subset cannot prove omitted recorder details or authenticate model generation independently

mapping.originals: Per-turn original_user_sha256, original_assistant_sha256, original_turn_record_sha256 and original_context_sha256
mapping.transformation: Keep only fictional user/observed assistant text, safe review, semantic API invocations and states. A public dialogue-only chain is computed separately; it is not the omitted original context.

Keep API method/args/kwargs/input/return/error and atomic state commitment; remove raw requests, execution paths, agent identity, read orchestration and receipt envelopes. clock_values contain only original API-result timestamps needed by deterministic replay.
Retain synthetic proof states and outcomes. Remove execution command paths; parse CLI stdout as JSON. Semantic values and all states remain intact.
Retain source-drift file/hash facts and neutral TypeError/no-state-change/recovery fact; omit private execution context.
Project actual log result counts; do not export runner names/paths or claim projected counts are byte-identical logs.
Exact TRACE/seed/has_origin/TerminalRetention/generated-test body retained; replace environment-specific import root and omit standalone output-writing footer.
Normalize source_path to the repository-relative design path; source_sha256 and every excerpt field/text remain exact original JSON values. Whole-file bytes are intentionally different.
Only original id, scenario, requirement and L+C layer retained

omitted_categories: executor absolute paths and tool orchestration
private archive handles and Library identifiers
coordination envelopes, raw controller instructions and registration records
duplicate original context and state files

value_pool.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon)
value_pool.reference: A one-key object $value identifies an expanded object by its canonical SHA256; no semantics or source timestamps change
